_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. This is the enrichment loop's only tuning surface for v1. Kept deliberately small; the shape is open so we can add fields later without a migration.

self._comment: Who YOU are — so the loop never adds you as a contact and can tell internal from external. Non-negotiable; fill this in.

scope._comment: Which emails to consider. Time-window is the real mechanism; the exclude_label is the 'already handled' watermark applied after each run.

ignore._comment: Never put these in the CRM. Grows over time: when you reject an 'add', its sender goes here. The single most important knob for keeping the CRM free of junk.

vocab._comment: The CRM's controlled vocabulary, mirrored from workspace.settings so proposals use valid values. Extend as your pipeline evolves.
